name: Owen Scott Muir
role: Psychiatrist; Chief Medical Officer, Radial; author of The Frontier Psychiatrists
bio: Child, adolescent, and adult psychiatrist. Co-founded Fermata (Brooklyn), an interventional psychiatry clinic, then joined Radial as Chief Medical Officer; also works with Neurolief. Writes The Frontier Psychiatrists on Substack (about 1,100 posts since May 2021) on interventional psychiatry, psychedelics, payers, and health policy.

name: Christian Angermayer
role: Founder, Apeiron Investment Group; co-founder and chairman, atai Life Sciences; early Compass Pathways investor
bio: German investor. Seed investor and long-time large shareholder in Compass Pathways (COMP360 psilocybin); co-founded atai Life Sciences in 2018, which merged with Beckley Psytech in 2025 and agreed to be acquired by Eli Lilly in July 2026. Public voice on X, LinkedIn, Substack, conferences, and podcasts.

name: Rick Doblin
role: Founder and president, MAPS; founder of MAPS PBC (later Lykos Therapeutics)
bio: Founded the Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic Studies in 1986 and led it for decades. Founded MAPS Public Benefit Corporation, renamed Lykos Therapeutics in 2024, which received a complete response letter for MDMA-assisted therapy in August 2024; left the Lykos board afterwards. Public voice in MAPS bulletins, conferences, and podcasts.

corpus.label: MAPS bulletins and 'From the desk of Rick Doblin'

name: Base rate
role: Published base rate by event class and stage, fixed at intake
bio: A reference row scored on the same items where a published base rate exists (BIO/Informa/QLS 2011-2020, Wong 2019, Daval 2023, Sacks 2014 and others). Halved when the item window is shorter than the class median time to decision.

name: Market
role: Prediction-market price up to 7 days before the statement
bio: A reference row scored only on items with a matching public market question (Metaculus, Manifold, Polymarket, Kalshi) whose deadline is within one quarter of the item's.
